dependencies.plugin_hash_role: local downloaded artifact provenance, not independently published signature
dependencies.jdk: verified distribution bundled JDK; no global JAVA_HOME or application secrets

modern_index_text: law_names then article_numbers then original chunk text, newline separated; all chunks retained
ik_dictionary: Unmodified packaged default dictionaries; extension and remote dictionaries empty, no custom case-derived words or hot updates; installed resources and configuration content hashes frozen
ik_query: Analyze with ik_smart, deduplicate tokens, bool should term OR minimum_should_match=1; no QueryParser, match rewrite, phrase, synonyms, fallback, fuzziness or boost; reject over 1024 unique tokens without truncation. Empty/full-OOV results are valid misses. Both HTTP requests included in query timing.
native_engine: Elasticsearch 9.1.4 / matching IK 9.1.4, explicit BM25 k1=1.5 b=0.75 discount_overlaps=true; one primary shard zero replicas, refresh then read-only index; native score-desc then chunk_id keyword UTF-8-asc sort before top-k; reject partial/timeout/malformed results
selection: Only complete stable three-arm runs permit selection. Rank modern arms by development Hit@5, then MRR@5, then lower second-pass client query p95. Selected modern arm must meet both same-run legacy Hit@5 and MRR@5 to be engineering-promotion eligible. No default or production promotion by this experiment.
runtime_scope: Direct lexical ranking only; an isolated owned local experimental service, no CLI/API/M2 production integration, exact route, generation, embedding, reranker or checker
timing_scope: Downloads and installation precede evaluation. One fresh worker per arm; ES worker owns one new cluster/index. Report service startup separately; build includes startup, bulk/refresh/freeze. Query includes analysis, IPC and search. Two forward/reverse passes; server took is auxiliary, not client latency.
memory_scope: Worker samples its own RSS plus live descendants including its spawned ES JVM at 20ms configured wait. Parent 200ms ownership sampler ensures timeout cleanup; both have overhead. Sampled simultaneous RSS maximum is neither exact OS peak nor index size, and excludes archive extraction/install.
network_boundary: Python worker audit allows TCP only to manifest-owned literal 127.0.0.1 HTTP port, no proxy/redirect/DNS/UDP/remote client; other workers deny sockets. ES HTTP/transport loopback, security auto setup off, geoip downloads/ML/watcher off, default IK remote URLs empty. No downloads/models during benchmark. JVM is not OS-airgapped; do not claim a firewall guarantee.
limits: 120 reused development cases; 108 retrieval-gold cases and 12 no-gold cases with NA ranking metrics, not inferred refusal successes
No independent legal review or unseen holdout; a fourth user-requested comparison increases selection bias
ik_smart is not a subset of ik_max_word; do not assume query-term coverage, repair OOV per case, or silently fall back
Historical versus modern differs in analyzer, modern metadata text, manual boosts, field statistics and engine; not a single-factor BM25 or segmentation causal comparison
Native Lucene norms, overlap positions and float scoring differ from BM25S; raw score scales are not comparable
One cold build, fixed arm order and sampled memory do not establish production capacity, API latency or deployment security
ES 9.1.4 is a compatibility/reproducibility pin, not a latest-version or production security recommendation; OpenSearch not tested
No case-specific dictionary, parameter/gold tuning or protocol changes after results; preserve all earlier runs

Any execution/cleanup failure, timeout, input/runtime identity drift, partial result, incomplete denominator or repeat mismatch invalidates winner selection; failures stay unknown rather than quality zero
